newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Medellin cartel enforcer killed in prison.
newsitem.headline: Medellin cartel enforcer killed in prison.

text.p: One of the most trusted aides of late Medellin cartel drug lord Pablo Escobar was shot to death on Thursday in a prison in the northwest city that gave the criminal drug syndicate its name.
Police said Juan Carlos Londono was gunned down by another prisoner whom they did not identify in Medellin's Bellavista prison.
Londono had been jailed since 1993 on a variety of charges stemming from his work as an "enforcer" or military chief of Escobar's notoriously violent drug organisation.
The charges included illegal weapons possession, and criminal and "terrorist" conspiracy.
Escobar, Colombia's most legendary and ruthless drug lord, died in a shootout with police on a Medellin rooftop in 1993.
